svg.title: Routing table: risk by confidence decides the next action for a pull request
svg.desc: A three by three grid. Rows are risk (low, medium, high) and columns are confidence (low, medium, high). Each cell names the next action: investigate, confirm, fast-track, decide, hold, or block.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How the two scores route a pull request
